A '''noble''' of the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] was suspected of having an affair by his [[Unidentified Tion noblewoman|wife]], who hired a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] to check his personal [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]] records for proof. It was revealed that the husband was not having one affair, but multiple ones, causing the wife to pay the slicer extra to clean out the cheater's financial accounts.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|For Better or Worse}}</ref>
